gates.name: python-recovery-checks
command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); /Volumes/Storage/StreamlitForge/.venv/bin/python -m venv "$tmp" && "$tmp/bin/pip" install -q --upgrade pip && "$tmp/bin/pip" install -q -e . pytest ruff && "$tmp/bin/python" -m pytest streamlitforge/tests -q && "$tmp/bin/ruff" check streamlitforge/patterns/learner.py streamlitforge/tests/integration/test_integration.py streamlitforge/tests/performance/test_performance.py streamlitforge/tests/test_api_keys.py streamlitforge/tests/test_cli.py streamlitforge/tests/test_patterns.py; code=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $code
